title: Witches Brew

fields.label: Function
fields.value: When used makes a witch laugh and adds a purple particle effect to the player

body:
Description

The witches Brew when used start a witch laugh sound and make the player emit a purple particle effect but doesn't do anything.

It costs $404 at the Classic Store and the description says:

Do the Brew! Shipped direct from the Haunted Hill soda company. Warning: may cause freakish deformities. Warning: may contain actual witches.
